mu_name_from: Data/Skill/PierPart.bmd, MODEL_PIER_PART (ZzzOpenData.cpp:4319), made by Fire Burst as it is let go (ZzzCharacter.cpp:5065-5086).
why_this_one: Fire Burst (AT_SKILL_FIREBURST): three sub-type 0 heads off his facing +90, 0 and -90, homing on the body he named for twenty frames, drawing mesh 0; every step stamps a sub-type 1 trail piece drawing mesh 1 at Scale 0.5, and a BITMAP_FIRE+1 with it (ZzzEffect.cpp:3381-3405, MoveHandlers.cpp:5598-5657). game/fx/fire_burst.h draws it; docs/plans/dark-lord-spells/fire-burst.md.
mesh_from: muextract export-obj on Data/Skill/PierPart.bmd: two meshes. m_Piercing, 120 triangles, an ellipsoid +-15 x +-15 x +-37 down its flight (the export's Z); m_Piercing02, 4 triangles, crossed quads +-25 x +-19 x +-37.

parts.note: Data/Skill/m_Piercing.OZT, 64 x 64, opaque: the head, lit and drawn with a normal blend (ZzzBMD.cpp:1532-1550).
Data/Skill/m_Piercing02.OZT, 32 x 32, its alpha cutting 70%: the trail pieces.

Not a mesh of PierPart: the sheet of the fire each trail piece lays, carried in this folder as Death Stab carries NSkill.png. Data/Effect/Fire02.OZJ (BITMAP_FIRE+1, ZzzOpenData.cpp:5180), 64 x 64; the same picture as content/effects/fire/fire02.png.
